prompts.name: Сторожевой склеп
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone landscape visual redesign concept for Sklep_1 in the existing game Dead Boat. INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the original Sklep subject and spatial identity: a low square OPEN-ROOF stone maze/crypt compound with a light tiled floor, internal zigzag corridor walls, several arched passages and four chunky squared corner piers with small red/blue accents. Preserve that recognizable maze footprint and low wall scale. Image 2 is STRICT GAME STYLE reference ONLY (do not copy its house or roof). Image 3 is STRICT plant colour/style reference (green foliage, violet blossoms). Match very simple Unity LOW-POLY game assets: broad flat matte colours, sharp planar stone faces, minimal large masonry courses, angular low-detail wood and faceted foliage. No realistic textures, no photorealism, no intricate sculpted stone, no painterly treatment, no exaggerated rounded bevels, no cinematic fog or dramatic lighting. The concept must look directly buildable using this project's modest assets. Camera at a HIGH three-quarter isometric angle like original, whole square compound and immediate entrance approach visible, so the entire winding path and interior rooms can be read. Broad daytime sunlight, plain blue sky and flat khaki/sand ground, no river, no snow. Corridor widths comfortable for a first-person player; no props, sarcophagi or plants blocking corridors. Every object supported. Preserve space for the existing lever and trap/ambush mechanics, represented simply, not replaced by a giant magical altar. No people, no HUD, no roof concealing the maze, no large tower or house. Single image NOT a collage or multi-panel sheet. Upper-left clean large variant NUMBER only. VARIANT 1: An intact guard crypt: warm pale-grey low stone perimeter and inner zigzag maze walls, four dark squared corner piers with restrained red-brown trim, a simple arched entrance centered in the near wall, two firmly wall-mounted warm lanterns at entrance and modest red cloth banners on two outer walls. Broad simple light stone floor slabs; one clearly reachable bronze lever on a squat block in a far inner chamber, a few inset dark rectangular floor trap panels, one coin or cup in a side alcove. A few flat stepping stones approach the entrance and one small angular green bush outside. Tidy restrained fortress details, no roofs over maze, no treasure piles, no grand building. Label: "1".
